faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Mauritius?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three straightforward tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial featuring up to 1,000,000 tokens per day, with billing starting only after the trial ends if not cancelled.

faq.q: Can Ceyo bots handle workflows in English and French?
faq.a: Yes. Ceyo agents fluently process, draft, and translate documents in English and French, as well as Mauritian Kreol context, making them ideal for local management companies and hospitality groups.

faq.q: Does my bot stop working when my computer or phone is off?
faq.a: No. Every Ceyo bot operates inside its own isolated cloud virtual machine. It continues browsing, executing scripts, monitoring data feeds, and answering calls 24/7 regardless of your internet connection or battery status.

faq.q: How does Ceyo integrate with Telegram?
faq.a: You can chat one-on-one with your bots on Telegram or add multiple specialized agents into a group chat, allowing them to collaborate as a coordinated digital operations team.

faq.q: Can Ceyo connect with our existing corporate software?
faq.a: Yes. Ceyo connects natively with more than 1,000 platforms, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Notion, Slack, popular CRMs, calendar systems, and cloud storage providers.
